172089.description:
A Japanese-style ayakashi Cinderella story! "You're the bride I've been searching for all this time." The ayakashi and humans coexist in harmony. The ayakashi, having superior abilities and beautiful appearances, sometimes find their partner among human women, making them their "bride". The bride, in exchange for bringing prosperity, receives absolute love from the ayakashi. Yuzu is constantly compared to her sister, a bride of a demon fox, and is resented by her family every day. One day, when Yuzu just couldn't take things anymore, a man appears before her on a bridge. This man is the most beautiful man Yuzu has ever seen... and he's calling her his wife?! "Just be quiet and let me hold you." The most powerful, "cold-hearted" ayakashi is pouring his heart out for Yuzu?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

172090.description:
Although he never wanted to see him again, S Class Esper Seo Leehyeon ends up meeting Jin Taewoo during his Guide matching test. In the past, they were each other's closest friend but their relationship fractured and broke due to a peculiar event. In an unexpected and unpleasant reunion, Jin Taewoo becomes Seo Leehyeon's exclusive Guide, due to their high compatibility. This guy, who's acting like he's taking revenge for the past, often gets on his nerves, and an aggressive guiding begins...

"No matter how many times you reject me, you were meant to end up falling into my clutches."

Can the Esper really escape from the Guide's revenge?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

172091.description:
This is a Japan where humans and supernatural ayakashi coexist in harmony. Being chosen to be the bride of a powerful ayakashi is both a dream and an honor. Yuzuko, an ordinary high school girl, has grown up being compared unfavorably to her sister, the chosen bride of a fox spirit. One day, however, Yuzuko meets a man of exceptional beauty, and her destiny will be dramatically changed.

"I have found her. My bride."

His name is Reiya Onryuin, an oni who stands at the top of the ayakashi world. Yuzuko is bewildered by Reiya's all-consuming love, but she escapes her family and finds her place by Reiya's side...?

(Source: Novema, translated)

172092.description:

172094.description:
One day, a mysterious name card lands on Hun-Sang's hand. The name card presents him a new life in a new city, the haven of adultery, along with a significant sum of money in return for his physique.

(Source: DAYcomics)

172095.description:
While working overseas, career woman Kang Min crosses paths with a charming Japanese man, Shibasaki Ken, during a chance encounter on the street. What was meant to be a one-night fling takes an unexpected turn when she runs into him again the next day—this time, at her workplace. This story explores the sweet, messy aftermath of a night that was supposed to mean nothing.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ロングアイランド・アイスティー〜ほろ苦い恋のカクテル〜

172096.description:
Yuzuko is now officially the bride of an oni. Even in her new married life, she is surrounded by Reiya's doting love, whispering sweetly to her. Then one day, Yuzuko receives an invitation to an exclusive tea party for ayakashi brides. Yuzuko goes to the party with Touko, a nekomata bride. But a dragon chases Yuzuko through the mansion, and when she reaches a shrine, she loses consciousness…

(Source: Novema, translated)

This exciting story involves the landing of a nuclear missile, code named “Nuclear Warhead,” in the North. Nuclear Warhead’s’ 69th mission is to subjugate a wealthy South Korean family’s daughter! However, due to an accident during his mission, he unexpectedly loses his memory.

Hanaoka is about to quit the yakuza and start his own ramen shop. It was going to be a hopeful new life with his pregnant wife, when tragedy strikes.... A phone call from someone who knows the truth draws Hanaoka back into the underworld, ruled by greed and violence.

At least, that's how it was supposed to go down! His 100th request has him forced to get close to the prince of the school, Tomo Nakano, but as Ume does, he witnesses a vicious rejection. As an excuse to get rid of the girl, the Prince suddenly kisses Ume! Not only has Ume lost his chance at that 100th successful couple and his clients' trust, but he has his first kiss stolen! Qu Qi went out with Tang Xia in college, but they broke up years ago. Now starting at a new job, she finds out her new boss is Tang Xi, her ex's older brother. 172151.description:
In a universe ripped from the pages of a story, Siena Robert, a self-aware villainess, strives to rewrite her fate. Daughter of a man running a therianthrope shelter, she discovers Ivan Levdilin, the captivating male lead, detained within. Aware of her scripted demise when Ivan's father arrives for his rescue, Siena defies her villainous destiny. She showers Ivan with kindness, a stark contrast to the original Siena's cruel persona. Her actions shield Ivan from her father's cruelty and forge an unscripted bond between them that changes their destiny in an unforeseen direction.

(Source: Tappytoon)

172152.description:
Jake, a struggling, jobless man, cannot afford to pay his rent. As his landlady pressures him on, he finds other ways to pay her back...

(Source: Toomics)

172153.description:
After losing his parents in a tragic car accident at a young age, Tae-Jun Kim vows never to forgive those responsible. Now, as an adult, fate reunites him with So-Eun Han, the daughter of the driver who took his parents' lives. Young, powerful, rich, and handsome Tae-Jun is hungry for revenge and will bully So-Eun until he feels satisfied. However, complications arise when love enters the equation, blurring the line between resentment and affection. A story in the making, in which "I will never forgive them!" turns into "I think I like you...".

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: I Can't Wait To Eat You

172154.description:
The year 2045 is the era of flourishing plants.

Parasite flowers mutated humanity into monsters in an instant. Only a few survived and constructed the underground 'City,' but they oppress and suppress the remaining humans as they please. Can 'Ga-Ram' find his brother Ga-On in this chaotic world?

(Source: Naver, translated)

172155.description:
“Fuck the hero.”

“Of course… Wait, what?"

A normal (?) office worker who’s fine after jacking off fifteen times in a row was summoned to another world. Who he met up with was not a goddess, but a demon lord? Plus, if he wants to return to his original world, he has to make the hero fall, something even the demon lord couldn’t do?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

synonyms: Color Girl: The Return of Lupin

172157.description:
Kazunari Imakura, a city boy born and bred, moves to the countryside for his parents' reasons. There, however, he meets Hironobu Ida, a beautiful boy who is clearly out of place! Imakura finds a diamond in the rough (= a beautiful boy) left unprotected, and awakens to a new fetish...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

172158.description:
They say what happens in school, stays in school. But for me… it somehow keeps following me around.

(Source: Toomics)

172164.description:
It's suppose to be an innocent newlywed life, but there is a big problem. My wife, who still has the mind of a child, doesn't know anything about adult matters! Even though we're husband and wife, I can't force her to do it, and I don't know how to explain it to her... Look at how they're jiggling all over the place! The unintentional teasing from my innocent young wife is going to drive me mad!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

172165.description:
Waking up as the main villain of his own novel was not part of the original plan. Now a lowly level 10 assassin, Ganghu Shin must use all of his prior knowledge as the author to navigate the fantasy world he created himself, and somehow alter the ending in order to return to the real world. Can he change the outcome and defeat the “real” villain to prevent his own demise and save this world from impending doom?

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: 自導自演的天才暗殺者

172166.description:
In a twist of fate, the life of a doctor of Korean medicine flips upside down in a single night. Doctor Han Lee is reborn as Lachiel, the sickly Crown Prince of the Empire of Magentano. Han is now armed with medical knowledge and skills found nowhere else in this new world -- but can he heal an empire and mend his own body at the same time? Witness his journey of self-exploration and resilience as he maps destiny's meridian, in pursuit of the acupoint that can reverse his fate.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Crown Prince That Sells Medicine
เจ้าชายแผนโบราณ

172168.description:
The ultimate partnership between a lady thief and her butler! "Lady Black" is a thief who wears all-black funeral dresses and targets only fine jewelry. Her true identity is Aria, the daughter of a jewelry dealer and a girl with a tragic past. One night, just as she was about to grab the jewel she wanted, a mysterious man gets in her way…!

(Source: Ciao Comics, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.
synonyms: 怪盗は今宵も花束を。～涙のジュエル～

title.romaji: Kaitou wa Koyoi mo Hanataba wo.

172169.description:
Hae-Jin is a young boy with an unyielding spirit, even in the face of relentless school bullies due to his frailty. His determination to grow stronger knows no bounds, but his body refuses to comply. Yet, Hae-Jin’s tenacity prevails.

One fateful day, he crosses paths with a homeless general, and a random act of kindness unveils hidden potential within Hae-Jin. The enigmatic general utters the cryptic phrase, “Martial arts do exist! ”

Join us on a journey as Hae-Jin, a prodigious talent in the realm of martial arts, sets out to conquer the modern martial arts world. His story is a testament to his unwavering dedication and the mysterious power that lies within.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Conqueror of Modern Martial Arts Kang Haejin

172170.description:
Yeongi, a sweet but clueless intern, is just trying to survive office life when he catches the eye of Bom, a fellow intern with a bold heart and zero chill. She's awkward, she's intense, and she's completely smitten—and she's not exactly subtle about it. From clumsy lunch invitations to over-the-top compliments, Bom launches a full-on (and very adorable) pursuit of Yeongi’s heart, much to the confusion of… well, everyone. Enter Yoonbin, the ever-serious team leader who accidentally catches a glimpse of their budding romance—and suddenly finds himself caught in the middle of a bizarre love comedy he never asked to star in. As misunderstandings pile up and office gossip spreads faster than a group chat, one thing’s for sure: This spring, love is in the air… but professionalism? Not so much. Is this the start of Yeongi’s first romance—or just another workplace disaster?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 僕の人生にもついに春が〜この三角関係、会社のみんなには秘密です〜
เมื่อฤดูใบไม้ผลิของฉันมาเยือน

172171.description:
In Europe, in France, in Paris in particular, the lives of three people intertwine as business and other affairs unfold. Yoshiaki Hongo is the polyglot son of a well-traveled Japanese banker, who now works as a "trader," or "smuggler." Narcissistic, he likes to work out and sculpt his body, to make up for his lack of stamina in bed. Rintaro Norimizu is a former member of the Japanese SDF and French Foreign Legion who fought in Chad and Libya. Now he is a mercenary who sells his services to the highest bidder. Fuchi is a Vietnamese woman of Chinese descent, a fashion model who fled Saigon by helicopter at the age of five, who likes to use her charms to get what she wants. Through four independent story-lines, we follow the misadventures of these characters, sometimes opposed and sometimes joining forces.

(Source: Pika, translated)

title.native: サムライ・ノングラータ

172172.description:
Tachibana's, a high school teacher, problem is that he has erectile dysfunction due to the shock of divorcing his wife. His younger colleague Odagiri, who is very fond of him, finds out about his problems and pressures him to "cooperate in treating his erectile dysfunction." Tachibana tries to refuse, but Odagiri reveals a desire he didn't even know he had!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

172174.description: Hajime Inukai is a student at the H University medical school, and she dreams of becoming a clinical doctor. However, for some reason, she's been assigned to work in a forensic medical science lab, under a weird, but incredibly skilled, associate professor called Kiriyama Yuki. Hajime hadn't expected her 'patients' to be corpses undergoing an autopsy, and she most certainly didn't expect the first case she attended to with Kiriyama would be the apparent suicide of a girl she knew. During their investigation of the case, Hajime also began to see flashes of the dead girl, as if she had come back to life for mere moments. Will Hajime be able to handle her time in forensic medicine, and work her way back to having living patients?
synonyms: Living Corpse Master: Queen of Forensic Pathology

title.native: 屍活師　女王の法医学

172175.description:
A cash-strapped young man's life changes overnight when a mysterious organization shows up at his door and offers him 100 million yen for his rare genetics. The catch? In order to claim the money, he must successfully father a child with an endangered male mermaid in order to save them from extinction!

(Source: KUMA)

172176.description:
Three years ago, Han Seo-Jun walked away from both the stage and the man he loved. To the public, he was nothing more than “the decent supporting role standing next to actor Choi Seung-Hyeon.” To Seo-Jun, the humiliation of being overshadowed by his partner, and the pain of leaving him behind, was enough to end his career altogether. Now, at 29, Seo-Jun’s world is far removed from the spotlight. He waits tables at a bar, scraping by on wages that disappear into debts and the money he dutifully sends to his parents in the countryside. His dreams are long buried, his heart heavier than his empty wallet. And then Seung-Hyeon appears again. Not as a memory, but in the flesh, standing in Seo-Jun’s workplace, urging him to act on stage once more.

The man he loved. The career he abandoned. Both return at once, reopening wounds Seo-Jun thought would never bleed again.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ปมร้าย พ่ายรัก

172177.description:
This story is set 10 years after the events of Hotaru Dies Tomorrow, where Nao Nimiya took the gamble of a lifetime to be with the bookworm Saneatsu Asada. The once-high schoolers now have proper jobs, but their love is still as sweet as ever...Yuuta and Mikami are also making progress! The following days are nothing short of blissful.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 47, was then licensed by Taiyohtosho for digital release.

172178.description:
In a world where Takafumi, the hero who defeated the Demon Lord, is worshiped as a god, Scott, a young priest, is assigned to the Church of Karma to spread the religion of Takafumi!

However, there is a problem with this church. The problem is that all the nuns here are… super, super, super naughty!!!!! They were all problematic children that they could not be accepted anywhere else!!!!!! One of the sisters would get totally drunk and cause trouble. Another sister held wild orgies with the villagers. And the third sister was so delusional that she would spread lewd rumors all over the place! Can Brother Scott rebuild the church, which is no longer attracting worshipers because of the strange sisters?!!!!! Or will Scott's rational thought be overwhelmed lust for the sisters first?!!!!

An ecchi fantasy, swirling with lust, set in a church! I'd go to a church like this every day!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Haruki, who loves fashion is working part-time in the clothing brand store "Berry" launched by her childhood friend Tadato. Haruki is doing very well as a top seller, until Kairi, a senior high school student who is very popular on social media, appears as a rival. What’s more, he tells her “If I win the sales competition, you have to start liking me!”.

A cheeky younger guy and a mature older childhood friend… in the dreamy world of fashion industry, a love triangle story begins!

(Source: Renta, translated)

Takeru has become unbearably horny after his older brother with his wife and daughter moved in with him (he's feeling it mainly due to his sister-in-law's moans), plus his niece Hikari showing off her healthy body in casual clothing.

It's gotten to the point where he wants to rub one out and find relief at once, but his own room is occupied and he has no private space for himself.

He is forced to endure this every day, and when he finally reaches his limit, Hikari whispers some sweet words to him:
"Should I help you rub one out?"

(Source: DLsite, translated)

172198.description:
Seo-Jin has been in love with his best friend, Jei, for 15 years. So when Jei announces his engagement, Seo-Jin can’t hide his feelings any longer and flees to Korea. But Jei, determined to understand why Seo-Jin left, follows him. Now living together in the same apartment, Seo-Jin’s emotions spiral. He wants to move on, but being so close to Jei makes it harder than ever to let go.

(Source: Tapas)

172206.description:
Kanata leads a peaceful, if not slightly dull, life in rural Hokkaido. The boredom is only compounded by the fact that Kanata's favorite utaite (online singer), Hyte, has stopped uploading new music. Enter Utagawa, a new transfer student from Tokyo. Kanata can't help but be drawn to the mysterious boy even though he insists he wants to be left alone. But when the class has to sing during music class, Kanata feels as if he's been struck by lightning when he hears the new student's voice...! Why is it so familiar...? Could Utagawa possibly be—?

(Source: Animate International)

Notes:
- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases. Bangai-hen 3 (番外編③) published on Pixiv Comic was not included in any of the volumes.
- Includes 11 extra chapters.

172207.description:
Leo, a mage, is expelled from the heroic party by Kane, the brave, because he just can't get on with. However, after Leo leaves, the party continues to lose. Kane asks Leo to return to the party, but Leo fed up with Kane's unmannerly attitude, asks Kane to get down on his knees... Kane's pride is shattered, and when Kane shows tears for the first time, Leo feels a certain excitement...?

(Source: Libre, translated)

Notes:
- Chapter 13 was split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release. “Stretch (ストレッチ)” published in Pixiv Comic was not included in any of the volumes.
- Includes six extra chapters.

title.native: 勇者の俺様が魔導士なんかに！
title.romaji: Yuusha no Ore-sama ga Madoushi Nanka ni!

172208.description:
Love starts from a misunderstanding...? A successful novelist and a college student who is an enthusiastic fan.

Tono looks scary but is actually a popular novelist. When he goes out for a walk to escape from reality, he encounters an enthusiastic fan...?

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title.native: いっそこれを運命と呼べ
title.romaji: Isso Kore wo Unmei to Yobe

172209.description:
Tasuku, a high school student, has a crush on Toki-sama, the black fox god of mourning who has lived with him since he was a child. He has been holding back for a long time, but in a moment of desperation, he makes a fool of himself and touches the naive Toki-sama and lies that he was grooming him. Tasuku is overwhelmed with regret, but it seems that Toki-sama likes "grooming"! An immoral love story between a high school student with a strong sexual desire and a bitchy god!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Notes:
- All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
- Includes 37 extra chapters.

172210.description:
Else von Roatte has never been loved by anyone. So when her servant Ian becomes the first person to show her kindness, Else knows she has to make him hers even if it’s against his will. As his master, she orders him to join her in bed each night, a fine line between duty and desire shadowing their every move. But little does Else know that Ian doesn’t actually hate her at all. In fact, Ian is secretly the exiled King Sybil, who plans to turn the tables and make Else entirely his once he reclaims his throne...

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: サベージ・キャッスル～堕落の迷宮～
强制爱了堕为奴隶的流亡君主

172211.description:
Kwon Woo-young and Ko Tae-sung were always the closest of friends—inseparable and unbreakable.

Their relationship took a drastic turn when Lee Soo-hwa, a timid classmate from high school, grew closer to Woo-young. Tension and jealousy began to simmer between the two friends, eventually erupting in a mysterious incident that shattered their bond.

Even after enrolling in university, they couldn’t repair their friendship. Struggling with his unresolved emotions, Woo-young chose to enlist in the army, hoping to bury his feelings for Tae-sung. But neither time nor distance could erase the complexity of his emotions. After his discharge, he moved into a new apartment—only to discover that Tae-sung was living in the same building.

What began as innocent friendship now burns with an intensity Woo-young can no longer deny.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: この関係に名前をつけるなら
ระหว่างฉันกับนาย

172212.description:
Gunmu Cha’s final mission is to steal a precious diamond. While gathering intel at a club, he saves Teo Yeon from getting blackmailed. But what business does he have with a rich kid who’s always at the center of drama? Gunmu needs to avoid getting involved with Teo for the sake of the mission, but their natural chemistry leads to one steamy encounter after another. As the secrets keep building between them, who will get burned first?

(Source: Tapas)

172213.description:
Hyun-U, a poor country boy studying in Seoul, buys a secondhand phone from an app. The seller, to his surprise, is quite attractive. However, not all is as it seems, as the pretty seller turns out to be... a dirty scammer. Enraged, Hyun-U vows vengeance. As luck would have it, the two meet again in a very unlikely scenario. As their paths continue to cross, will they end up fighting until the very end? Or will there be a more... pleasant ending for them both?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: イチゴマーケット〜俺を騙した女と恋なんて〜

172214.description:
Kazunari Hira is not what you'd call popular. In fact, he's basically on the lowest rung of the social ladder, due largely to his stutter that tends to flare up when he's anxious. And then there's him: Sou Kiyoi, leader of the pack and the most beautiful man Hira has ever seen. When Hira is made the popular group's gofer, he realizes that he doesn't mind his lowly position so much when the orders are coming from Kiyoi's lips. In fact, Hira treasures every order Kiyoi gives him and every bit of change he's handed to run errands. Could he actually be... in love?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

172215.description:
Kazunari Hira, in what must be a tremendously huge mistake by God, is now dating the most beautiful man in the world—Sou Kiyoi. As the two of them start to navigate their relationship into adulthood, they realize their communication really isn't the greatest. While Hira sees Kiyoi as an untouchable star in the night sky, Kiyoi sees Hira as his gross, annoying boyfriend. Kiyoi begins to wonder if Hira will ever be able to love him like a real boyfriend would or if he'll just keep worshiping him like a king. "Stupid Hira... you're such a hateful guy..."

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

172216.description:
Even from a young age Hira was an introvert, too nervous to speak up, disappearing into the crowd at his high school. From afar he admires his classmate, Kiyoi, ruling as the king of the class with his handsome looks and his aloof attitude. To him, everyone is equally worthless. With his low self-esteem, Hira is happy to play his part as Kiyoi's loyal gopher, but even he's surprised when he finds Kiyoi's phone number added to his cellphone. Every glance, every scrap of attention is precious. Could these lonely, suffocating feelings actually be love?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

172217.description:
Haku finally has Oumi, the man he longed for desperately, but tried to give up thinking that it would never come true, as his lover. He'd embrace Oumi as if to make sure...?

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

172219.description:
Shinguu Aoi is the most popular guy in school. He is so popular that he is unable to have a "normal youth." As he longs for youth with his friends and girlfriend, he meets a boy with a ridiculously handsome face, Yamada Makoto, in his search for someone who can steal the eyes of the whole school for him. But he is, surprisingly, a hardcore "mob" who has spent more than a decade of his life as a "background character"...!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Notes:
- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases. Bangai-hen 3 to 15 (番外編) published on Pixiv Comic were not included in any of the volumes.
- Include three extra chapters.

title.native: イケメン様でも青春したい！

172220.description:
Hwang A-Yeong is a classmate who lived next door to Hyeon-Su. She left Hyeon-Su in her second year of high school and went to the U.S. for studies. Hyeon-Su, who is now a college student, one day at home alone sees an underwear shopping mall called ‘Flirting’. Heart pounding, he witnesses an intimate affair between the a man and a woman in the house where A-Yeong lived! Hyeon-Su is so shocked that he freaks out. The next day, Hyeon-Su wakes up to see A-Yeong, who he’s dreamt of, as the boss of the underwear shopping mall! What’s more, she wants him to help with the business! In a confusing turn of events, among the staff in the underwear shopping mall, the woman who had an affair the previous day, recognizes Hyeon-Su. Things begin to take a strange turn…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

172221.description:
After suffering both scam and divorce, Chu Minsik teeters on the edge of financial ruin. Still, he doesn't let it completely ruin his humanity - a fact soon rewarded when the old man he helps out turns out to be more than meets the eye. Minsik is rewarded for his help, being told that the key to his future lies within his dreams... Specifically, dreams where he dates oh-so-sexy women! Each dream is guaranteed to tell him which crypto he should invest in the next day, turning him into somewhat of an overnight success! Money, fame, and women - what more could a guy want!

(Source: Lezhin US)

172222.description:
Lim Bonha, the youngest daughter of the Y Corp family, has it all—looks, wealth, and charm. But for the past 14 years, she’s been hopelessly in love with her first crush, Lee Eunho. Now, as a confident and stunning young woman, Bonha is determined to put an end to her one-sided love. She’s ready to make him hers, no matter what. The only problem? Eunho still sees her as the little girl from 14 years ago. But for this relentless heiress, that’s just a minor obstacle.

"Would you marry me, Eunho? And just so you know, the only acceptable answer is Yes!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

172223.description:
The first love who disappeared 14 years ago reappears before him! Jae-Hyuk, who lost his close friends Jun-Young and Chun-Ha in a gruesome unsolved murder during his high school days, cannot forget that day and becomes a police officer. As time passes and the statute of limitations expires, Jae-Hyuk is able to reinvestigate the case. He returns to his hometown after 14 years, but much has changed. But then, Chun-Ha, his first love who vanished 14 years ago, reappears before Jae-Hyuk...!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

172224.description:
23-year-old Jongsoo is your average guy who has nothing much to show for himself save his youth. He’s got an interest in video production but not much experience. When he sees a job post for Europe Entertainment, he figures he’ll apply and give it his best shot. But when he arrives at the building he’s pleasantly surprised by how nice it is…and by all the female workers he’s passing by… There’s something a bit suspicious about this place that he can’t quite put his finger on but Jongsoo, with nothing to lose, has decided to go all-in on this opportunity! Even if the place is a little weird, at least the job comes with some tempting benefits…!

(Source: Lezhin US)

172225.description:
Boasting a kempt appearance and brains to boot, Yaha seemed to have everything required to become the queen. But she lacked one very important skill - the one required upon nightfall in his majesty’s chambers. After being ignored by the king on their first night as a married couple, Yaha’s anxieties multiply amongst rumors that the gorgeous court lady Seo-kyung has been reappointed. In order to overcome this challenge, Yaha summons a famous “novelist” to the palace for some private lessons. It’s clear that Yaha has much to learn, but just how far will they take these lessons…?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 夜呀〜咲き乱れる王の花〜

172226.description:
Jiyeon finds herself in disbelief after waking up next to someone twelve years younger. As she tries to gather her thoughts, she can’t wrap her head around the situation—she just had a one-night stand with a guy who used to be just a kid in her eyes. Five years ago, Minjun, the neighborhood high schooler, confessed his feelings to her, but she didn’t take him seriously. Now, he’s back, no longer a boy, but a man. After a chance encounter at a bar, Jiyeon reconnects with Minjun, who is now a bartender. As their past connection resurfaces, Jiyeon is torn between the memories of the boy he was and the man he's become. Minjun is determined not to lose her this time, and Jiyeon must come to terms with the fact that he’s no longer the playful kid—he’s grown up and ready for something real.

(Source: Lezhin US)

There, elderly people are living alone with their cats, waiting for their "solitary death" that will come someday. What kind of story will they face tomorrow? The author, 76 years old and living in an apartment complex herself, depicts the overwhelming present as the future for all of us. The latest work by Saito Nazuna, winner of the Japan Cartoonists Association excellence award and the manga division of the Japan Media Arts Festival Manga's excellence prize for "Yuugure e."

172272.description:
This is a collection of 11 short manga by Otomo Katsuhiro, who was 17-19 years old between 1971 and 1974, from the period when he was a student contributor to his professional debut.

Otomo made his debut at the age of just 19 with Juusei in the August 4th,1973 extra issue of Manga Action, and none of his first seven short stories have been collected in any previous book. You may have seen them listed in Short Peace, but this will be the first time you can read them. The stories in this book are literally "phantom early works." This book includes all of these works for the first time, as well as four completely unpublished works, and drafts and submissions made before the artist's debut. It is a miracle that the manuscripts of these works still exist, but the author's permission to include these unpublished works was also a special measure taken for the "complete works" project, and the realization of this book is truly a once in a half-century miracle.

It is up to the reader to decide whether to dismiss it as a collection of crude, poor, immature works or to be astounded by this "formidable child's" simultaneously youthful and mature sense of expression that is hard to believe came from a teenage boy. The value of this book is immeasurable as a one-of-a-kind document that records the moment when a creator who would later make a name for himself in the world was born, as well as the moments before and after.

Only 10 years after his debut, in 1983, the still unknown "monster" began to draw AKIRA. Finally, his work is resurrected here!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

172279.description:
Mangaka Eiichi Muraoka reflects on his life as a manga artist spanning more than 50 years. In this sad but beautiful memoir of the Showa-era manga artist's youth, he captures the unforgettable radiance of a single moment in time, as he interacted with people he hasn't seen again and those he can never see again.

"It has been more than 54 years since I made my debut at the age of 19. I had some unfinished business, and I suffered a cerebral hemorrhage that left me paralyzed on the right side of my body, so I had to quit drawing. However, the warmth of everyone's voice led to my unexpected journey home. I'm truly grateful. Thank you."

- September 2nd, 2023 Eiichi Muraoka

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

172282.description:
Did you not wish to see me, My Lord…? I’ve taken over a man’s body in the world of murim, and to make things even more complicated, it’s the body of an extra in a world where everything is determined by strength and skills. There’s only one way to survive and make it out of this place. Women? Power? I will take everything away from the original protagonist and rewrite the novel!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: I Ended Up in the World of Murim

172283.description:
The first kanji in the word bicycle, "jitensha," is the first kanji in freedom, "jiyuu!"

Kuroda Iou has many ardent fans for his one-of-a-kind worldview in works such as "Nasu" and "Sexy Voice & Robot." This is an astonishing collection of his bicycle manga, which was serialized in Cycle Sports magazine, a long-established bicycle magazine, for two years starting from the January 2021 issue! Kuroda pedaled his bicycle. He pedaled his manga. He pedaled freely. He pedaled his bicycle up the hills of Shinjuku, down the mountains of Mars, and all the way into the sky.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

172284.description: Set 30 years after the original, the story of the confectionary store continues.

172285.description:
After defeating the Demon King, all that was left for the hero was the betrayal and neglect from his comrades. Then, a goddess decides to grant him a wish.

“My wish is to return to the past and have those bitches who abandoned me pay the price.”

(Source: DAYcomics)

172286.description:
Welcome to Hellevator!

A renowned prison escapee is sentenced to the 666th floor of Hell, and attempts to break away from his fate. Will the elevator girls be able to catch him?

title.native: ヘルベーターへようこそ

172287.description:
After dying in a car accident, an office worker finds herself reincarnated as Giselle Rozevin, a villain doomed to be poisoned while awaiting a death sentence. Although many assassins try to poison her, they all end up failing! In fact, the poisons Giselle ingests actually taste… good?! Can Giselle leverage this ability to survive her new surroundings?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Will Become a Poison Detector in the Dark World
ฉันจะเป็นนักตรวจสอบพิษให้วายร้าย

title.english: I Will Become the Villain's Poison Taster

172288.description:
People become ‘ghouls’ upon dying, and will enter the physical world through a door to cause chaos. Zhang Zha, a mere delivery boy, accidentally entered a haunted house, and resulted in a crisis— a ‘ghoul’ breakout. As such, people from all factions began to make an appearance in the story, while Zhang Zha continues to grow upon experiencing a series of adventures and fights with a mysterious scroll about modern Jianghu slowly unfolding alongside.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

172289.description: Zhang Yuan, who died overworking from 9am to 9pm 6 days a week, entered the mental system he created — the strongest villain system in history. He became the strongest villain — the demon lord. Zhang Yuan could totally destroy all the humans in that world with one finger and complete his mission, but he doesn’t want to! He wants to enjoy retirement life in this system! When the slackest MC meets the most hardworking system, they go against common sense! Think outside the box! Enjoy the apex of life! Get everything he wants!

The Villain of Destiny Me Has Become the Righteous Patriarch

172290.description:
"I can't log out?!"

Esperanza finds herself trapped in a virtual reality game and unable to log out. Suddenly, she is transported 13 years into the past and finds herself stuck in the eerie mansion of the mad scientist, the Earl of Avenedale. In order to escape, Esperanza teams up with Lord Avendale to complete a quest that will hopefully allow her to return to reality.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: La chasseuse et le savant fou

title.english: The Huntress and the Mad Scientist
title.native: アボンデール伯爵の秘密

172291.description:
I came into the world of a novel I was reading, and became an unknown extra destined for a miserable life. Teaching manners to a crazy bastard who turns into a tyrant? Manners, my ass! Quick thinking was my only means of survival. I tried everything to prevent such a tragic relationship with the tyrant from happening. I kicked, punched and screamed my head off, but I was still beaten in the end. Actually, he’s unexpectedly docile at times and even told me,

“You’re the first person who understands me.” The male lead’s personality is strange.

“Anyway, you shouldn’t do that to a woman.”

“Isn’t it okay to kiss in a bind?”

“No! I meant that you can’t kiss someone without their permission.” Somewhat miffed, Croft then gave a mischievous grin as he approached her.

Bending down to Rivi’s eye level, he asked in a soft voice with glimmering red eyes, “So you’re saying there’s no problem if you give me permission?” After hearing his words, Rivier’s heart pounded in trepidation. Tugging at her hand, he held it tightly, pulling his elbow as far as he could, before he stretched his arm out like a bow. Bam! Rivier accurately jabbed Croft’s abdomen. Wait, why is there such a hard lump?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

172292.description:
The only thing he can believe in is money. Due to a traumatic experience, Fujino works as a janitor by day and a prostitute by night. He dislikes Amami, a perfect and elite superhuman who is the talk of the town at his workplace, but when he meets a customer as a prostitute as usual, the one who shows up is the rumored Amami...?

A natural air-head & obsessive perfect scion x a call boy who loves money! What will happen to the two liars playing lovers connected by money...?

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

172295.description:
Laviore Rea Bailey, the fake saint and heartless puppet of the merciless Prince Sidar, drinks poison on the day the prince is to give her up as an offering to the devil. Instead of dying, she reincarnates 10 years in the past. Set on righting her previous wrongs, Laviore vows to save the slave Damian Rhode Drake, whom she had once framed as a spy. As she gets closer to the mysterious Damian, new feelings start to emerge, but will this former villainess truly be able to change her ways?

(Source: Tapas)

172300.description:
Mary didn’t know what to expect of the afterlife, but it certainly wasn’t becoming the evil, murderous nanny of the novel she was reading. Her circumstances become secondary concerns when she realizes that no matter what, Briel must remain safe. It’s the only way to keep his uncle, Count Kentryle Chalant, from the path of revenge. Can she keep her new charge safe and change the entire plot, or will the true villain get the best of them all? And is she going to find love on the way?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ไดอารีการเลี้ยงเด็กร่วมกับวายร้าย

172303.description:
I ended up possessing the body of an extra named Luberia, who is barely mentioned in the story. And right in the tragic novel “Emperor Caesar”, full of wars and disasters, where the protagonist sacrifices everything for the love of the hero and everyone ends up dying! I planned to live discreetly and hide my strength...

But the male lead, Caesar, keeps looking for me and even proposes marriage, saying he wants to keep me around. Luberia doesn't want to meet the same tragic end as the protagonist, so she tries to avoid Caesar at all costs... But due to Caesar's intimidating appearance and assertiveness, before she knows it, she ends up engaged to him.

Will Luberia manage not to fall in love with Caesar and survive until the end?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes three side story chapters.
synonyms: The Male Lead Is Trying to Change the Female Lead
脇役のはずが、主人公に求婚されています

172306.description:
As captain of the holy knights, Celia excels at protecting the country from monsters. So, when a priestess tasks her with raising a baby nine-tailed fox, Celia is hesitant but does her best to help the creature. Despite the abuse he has endured from other humans, she manages to gain some of his trust and names him Rahn. They start getting along, but the crafty fox is always looking for a way to escape. Can Celia raise Rahn until he's an adult, or will this sly fox pull one over his holy knight?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Raised a Nine Tailed Fox Wrongly

title.english: How to Raise a Nine-Tailed Fox

172307.description:
Reporter Hiiragi catches a lucky break—a photo of the up-and-coming actor Minami disappearing into a love hotel. A scoop practically begging to be written! But Minami storms into Hiiragi's office the next day, insisting the photo is a misunderstanding. On a whim, Hiiragi throws out a scandalous proposition: his silence in exchange for...Minami's body! What started as a playful jab quickly turns serious as Hiiragi finds himself unexpectedly drawn to Minami's genuine personality...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.
172307.hashtag: #イノセント・スキャンダル

title.native: イノセント・スキャンダル

172309.description:
Shirakawa-san and Meguro-kun, two bookworms share the common goal of reading all the books in the library before graduation. One day, after struggling to interpret a romance novel, they decide to actually go out to deepen their understanding of the work. First, they try to get closer by going on a date down to school, but Meguro-kun reveals that he has liked Shirakawa-san for a long time. 

(natalie.mu / translated)

172310.description:
After watching his first love marry his best friend, Eins Lainswaine resigns himself to life with another violet-eyed woman. Ye-Hi Lee never expected to be part of his story, until she is reincarnated as Eins’ reluctant wife, Märchen Lainswaine. On the bright side, twins Lieph and Joseph remind Ye-Hi Lee of her deceased siblings at every turn. Could the Lainswaines overcome a lifetime of tragic accidents (and mysterious circumstances) to become adoptive parents…and maybe even something more?

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: I Ended Up Raising the Children of the Female Lead and the Male Lead

title.english: Raising the Children of the Main Characters

172313.description:
She became the villain of a novel. And not just any villain, but one who committed several crimes and was expelled from her family! Having no other choice, she started selling food on the streets to survive... But, suddenly, she was kidnapped by the prince of the empire and the villain of the novel. “I want you to be my personal cook,” he said.

But why is he interested in me? After many twists and turns, she became the emperor's exclusive cook and followed a quiet but dull path... Until she discovered that her food had a special effect on people. A genius alchemist, a rival chef, a mysterious fox... Everyone fell in love with her food and with her. And, above all, the emperor, who was the supposed villain, was very kind and protective of her. But, she just wanted to cook in peace!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I'm a Villainess, but I'm Good at Cooking

172314.description:
After a close call with death, Iris has a sudden revelation: she's been living inside a novel from her past life. But if her memory's correct, all the characters in the novel, herself included, ultimately meet their demise at the hands of the villain, Theo. Determined to survive, Iris resolves to befriend Theo in hopes of reforming him while he's still young. At first, everything seems to go according to plan... But when she reunites with him ten years later, she realizes something's gone terribly wrong. Why is the same ruthless villain she saw in the novel... standing before her?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I Thought I Tamed the Villain

title.english: I Thought I Tamed the Villain

172315.description:
After a near-death experience, something has changed about the Holy Emperor’s troublemaker of a grandson. To be precise, his body was taken over by a Korean man who died while playing a VR video game! But when his necromancer character is mixed with a Holy Prince’s blood, things start getting funky. The zombies he makes are incredibly nice, his curses start healing people, and the girl he saved from being turned into a zombie suddenly gains super strength. Now he has to play the hero, but he’d really rather just go for a nap.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Holy Emperor's Grandson is a Necromancer

172316.description:
The newly reincarnated Sheriel learns she has become the mother of Karthizel Roperam, the male lead of a dark romance fantasy novel. All the neglect Karthizel faces as a child leads him to become a crazy and obsessive man who’s willing to kill anyone to get what he wants, even his own mother! Then the only way for Sheriel to keep herself alive in this timeline is to have him be raised right under loving parents, which means she’ll also need to make amends with her cold, estranged husband. Will Sheriel be able to save herself and this broken family?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

ฉันกลายเป็นแม่พระเอกนิยายจอมเสเพล
Je suis la mère du anti-héros
I Won’t Let My Son Become the Evil Male Lead!

title.english: I Became the Mother of the Evil Male Lead

172317.description:
Centuries ago, Hestia was born with incredible magic, so she was the only one powerful enough to sacrifice herself to save the world from a great evil. Now, she has been reborn into a new body and retained her magic and memories from her past life. Hestia's only goal in this life is to make her sister happy. The only problem is her sister wants to marry Yanik, an immortal who's been waiting for Hestia's return. Can Hestia keep Yanik from discovering her identity so that her sister can marry him?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapters.

172318.description:
After sacrificing herself to save the world over 99 different lifetimes, Anastasia Enderblanc starts her 100th life with frustrated resignation. Born as the youngest child of House Enderblanc, she expects another abusive family that fears her power, but is confused when they shower her with love instead. Their genuine affection surprises her, but she keeps waiting for the other shoe to drop. Can Anastasia accept the Enderblancs' love, or will she be disappointed and betrayed once more?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: First Time as a Loved Youngest Child
It's My First Time Being Loved
第一次成為受寵小女兒
愛され末っ子は初めてで
ครั้งแรกกับการเป็นลูกคนเล็กผู้ได้รับความรัก
A Caculinha da Familia Nunca Teve Amor Assim

title.english: Being Loved for the First Time

172319.description:
Since being marked as a saint at the tender age of 8, Gloria has been slaying demons and healing soldiers on the battlefield. That is, until one day, the Empire decides to cast her aside in favor of a new, more docile saint by framing her as a fake. Quick to switch to solution mode, Gloria assembles a motley crew and sets up a plan to take revenge on those who wronged her. With her hunky acolytes and her trusted mace in hand, can she restore her honor and make the damned rascals pay?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

172320.description:
In a world where magic co-exists with the rule of nobles, Adrian Lawrence seemed to have gotten lucky in life as the second son of a viscount. Despite this, Adrian is an outcast in a home controlled by his scheming stepmother and half-brother, who are set on ousting him. Little do they know that Adrian plays the game Chronicle Online, where he possesses great powers that can also be used in reality! With heirship to the viscounty up for grabs, can Adrian use his powers to level up his real life?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: My Lucky Encounter From the Game Turned Into Reality

172335.description:
The story follows three mystery-solving male models: Maneki Kei, who has a strange tendency to be the first to discover bodies, mystery nerd Suou Itsuki, and flirtatious Simon Touma.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

172337.description: Mako, 26, is in the hospital for the first time in her life, suffering from hemorrhoids. There she encounters a rather handsome man named Tadashi Yoshinaga in the waiting room with the same problem. When they left the hospital together, Tadashi's mother happened to be waiting in the car outside. "Is that your friend? Invite her to the house!" And so Mako goes to visit Tadashi's home!

172338.description:
"I want you, Moka..." There's a popular guy in class, and he can't stand the way the other girls look at him. The only girl he wants all for himself... is the plain girl sitting in the seat in front of him?! Moka Asano is your average high school girl, and sitting behind her is Izumi Kurosaki. Kurosaki is the captain of the soccer team, and he's so popular that the neighboring schools have fan clubs for him! The girls always crowd around his desk, so Moka can never get a chance to sit down at her desk in the morning... but everything changes when Moka gets the chance to be close to Kurosaki when they see each other in the old school library. Even though Kurosaki hates being around girls, and tends to give everyone these cold stares, he looks at Moka with a bright smile and asks her "do you wanna date for real?" It's like he's a completely different person!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Kurosaki Wants Me All to Himself ~The Intense Sweetness of First Love~
title.native: 黒崎くんは独占したがる～はじめての恋は甘すぎて～
title.romaji: Kurosaki-kun wa Dokusen Shitagaru: Hajimete no Koi wa Amasugite

172339.description:
One year after the end of the Pacific War, Kadode, a surviving member of a kamikaze squad, works at a building site in Tokyo, which he calls the grave of his former comrades. Then, Kadode hears that if he can find "Scarlet," he can earn a large reward for it. It turns out Scarlet is a third atomic bomb that the U.S. military was about to drop on Tokyo at the end of the war! The battle over the "third bomb" is about to begin, in a story of postwar nuclear survival!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 終戦後のスカーレット

172340.description:
Ruka Shiota is obsessed with his older brother so much so that every relationship he enters ends the same way. No matter how hard he tries he cannot help comparing his boyfriends to his brother only to be dumped with harsh words like “I am sick of your selfishness” or “Why do not you just date your brother instead?” Each time Ruka turns to his favorite host club where the No 1 host Kei listens patiently to his complaints. But one day the unthinkable happens Rukas beloved brother gets a boyfriend of his own. Devastated Ruka runs to Kei as usual only to hear him whisper, “I will be the one to make you happy.”

(Source: Kadokawa, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
172340.hashtag: #俺を選んでよワガママくん

title.native: 俺を選んでよワガママくん

172341.description:
In the Kingdom of Niels, where dragons fly, Kyle, a "half-demon" knight of demonic descent who can speak the tongue of dragons, has a fateful reunion with his past lover, Alfred. Three years ago, for reasons he keeps to himself, Kyle bade farewell to his boyfriend, though he has never forgotten about him. But Alfred, who had once been his direct superior, is now just a count of the borders, a margrave, while he is but an ordinary knight. Kyle also holds a certain secret, which he can never tell Alfred... Since he has no right to by his side, Kyle tries to distance himself from Alfred, but Alfred won't allow them to part―?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)
synonyms: The Half-Demon Dragon Knight Is Obsessed With the Markgraf

172342.description:
A "fish man" moves in next door to the dull 35-year-old Shiori, and her dull everyday life changes drastically! Why does the fish man sometimes look so handsome? And Shiori's love begins...

(Source: Cycomics, translated)

172442.description:
Taniya, a member of the accounting department, does not like irregularities and prefers to live a quiet, unassuming life. One day, he is coaxed to attend a drinking party by a colleague where he runs into paperwork resubmission man?! His name, Irobe, and he was someone Taniya would seemingly never be able to get along with, until a conversation between them proved to be unexpectedly, pleasant. On their way home, while Taniya was basking in the ambiance of good vibes, he's suddenly kissed by Irobe. He spends his lonely days at his tattoo shop, where he illegally has been taking on name removal jobs, a “name” being a mark on a person’s body that indicates their soulmate. Despite claiming he is now done working on names, a gangster called Seong Wonjae insists he be his last client. But unbeknownst to Sawol, Wonjae’s true intention is to find out why his name throbbed intensely the moment he laid eyes on the tattoo artist...

(Source: Tappytoon)

172444.description:

It wasn't until Nat-chan lets out her true feelings one night while sleeptalking, that the two realize what was really important.

After living through an unspeakably traumatic childhood, Naeyeong refuses to even touch another human being. But things start to change the day Jin enters his cold, isolated world, bringing in a familiar warmth that Naeyeong had been stripped of along with his innocence. Unfortunately, Naeyeong still drowns within the ghosts of his past and is out for revenge against all those who submerged his life into suffocating darkness. He knows that with what he’s planning, he’s no good for Jin. And yet, is it even possible to stay away from the man who allows him to breathe again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

"Welcome to the Kindom's capital, Glendia!"

The gatekeeper, who greets every visitor to the royal city of Glendia, is very...... ordinary.

No one cared about him leave the city. But because he had been fighting against the super-powerful monsters lurking in the sewers of the city, he had become incredibly powerful. Unaware of this, the gatekeeper sets off to find work in the countryside. He gets himself a cute apprentice, and the local people depend on him, but he is continuously amazed at all of the powerful acts that (he thinks) are beyond his abilities. Misunderstanding leads to more misunderstanding, and the gatekeeper becomes a hero without being aware of it.

As Hellgates open across the globe, humanity falls, bringing with it the death of Goong Nam’s family. On the edge of a cliff, he loses hold of his beloved daughter’s hand as she falls straight into the jaws of a fiend. He wishes to reach out one more time with his shattered arm and grab her hand. He wishes to turn back time. These wishes can be granted, but for a price: completing a legendary quest by offering the heads of 666,666 high-ranking demons. Thus begins Goong’s unrelenting, blood-soaked battle, filled with chaos and an unyielding love for his family.

On lonely nights, she likes to go out on the balcony to catch the night breeze, and to have a drink and a smoke. One night, her neighbor saw her through the partition and began talking, and their relationship began. The two of them are separated by their time together. Saku and his brother Mangetsu, members of the dragon tribe, act as traveling entertainers to search for other dragons. They use their supernatural powers to quell the incidents caused by the strange creatures they encounter and bring peace to the hearts of the people they meet. In this story, the two arrive in a town where mysterious fires break out frequently. Soon after, a suspicious presence approaches them.

(Source: Aokishi, translated)

172589.description:
Saku, a street performer traveling in search of dragons, is captured by bandits while searching for his lost younger brother, Mangetsu. When he tells the bandits his story, they say that his brother must have been kidnapped by the youkai who live at the top of the mountain. Saku joins forces with the bandits, who say they are going to attack the youkai, and sets out for the mountaintop.

The start of Ryuu Kouryo, a fantastic new series by an ace Taiwanese mangaka!

(Source: Aokishi, translated)

The middle-aged airsoft enthusiast Daisuke Koga is summoned to a another world on his 40th birthday. Given the ability to turn airsoft guns into real guns while traveling back and forth between two worlds, Daisuke must find a way to save the other world. Alongside the lady swordsman Rena, Daisuke becomes the only gun user in this fantasy world, and he will come to dominate it with overwhelming firepower every day after work!

172607.description:
Once thriving but now facing financial ruin, Jang Solbi becomes the secretary of Choi Seokyoon, the chairman of a powerful corporation. Grateful for the support during her family's hardship, she works tirelessly to repay their debt. However, following the loss of her parents, Solbi uncovers the dark truth behind their tragedy and seeks revenge against Chairman Choi. After years spent working for him, the moment finally arrives, yet her plans are foiled by Choi's son, Leehwan. Even after witnessing Solbi's hatred towards his father, Leehwan proposes a disturbing deal: comply with him, and he'll overlook her attempted murder. Despite her initial repulsion, Solbi reluctantly accepts, hoping for a second chance. As time passes, she discovers an unexpected attraction to Leehwan. Is her interest mere curiosity, or is this evolving relationship destined to become something deeper?

(Source: Lezhin US)

172612.description:
Ochikubo Monogatari (落窪物語), also known as The Tale of Ochikubo, is a story from the Heian period which is similar to the famous fairy tale Cinderella.

After suffering from relentless harassment from her stepmother, Princess Ochikubo meets a man named Michiyori who is a general. The two marry and Princess Ochikubo lives very happily with him. Michiyori starts to take revenge on Princess Ochikubo's family, setting up a series of humiliating events.

Adapted into manga by Eiko Hanamura for the Manga Nihon no Koten series, wherein several acclaimed manga artists adapted classic Japanese literature from the Heian to Edo period.

172613.description:
Koi Ikeno celebrated the 30th anniversary of her debut in 2009. These short stories from 1985, which had not been included in any books until now, are now collected in one volume. The book also includes an interview, and it is a collection that fans have long been waiting for!

Centuries ago, the emergence of a monster-filled tower heralded the apocalypse. Only clearing the tower can save the world and Xiao Lin, the light of humanity, is the only one capable of such a feat. Unfortunately for him, this is not his story. After being one-shot by the monster king, the legend of Xiao Lin comes to an end and Demon Lord Ming Jiu's begins.

172616.description:
When medical examiner Yarra Lin meets detective Kelsey Song, what starts as a fiery clash between them gradually turns into a deep connection and partnership. Together, they bear witness to the lives of a host of ordinary people: an innocent girl who died unjustly, an elderly mother waiting in the mountains for her criminal son to return, a timid rookie cop who risked his life to confront an armed robber... They fight for justice for the living and give a voice to the dead, uncovering countless hidden truths along the way.

(Source: Webcomics)

172617.description:
The percentage of foreign residents in Tokyo: 3.98%. In percentage terms, that's not much, but there's than meets the eye. Mari Konoda, a member of the International Investigation Section of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, and Ryo Arigino, a police interpreter, are faced with cases involving foreigners who have come to Japan for various reasons and have either been involved in crimes or have committed crimes. What should you do if you are suddenly arrested in a country where you don't understand the language...?

"A child kidnapped from home...? I didn't know such a thing was possible in Japan..."

The two investigators will reveal the underbelly of international crime in Japan and the harsh reality behind those criminals. A new kind of police manga featuring a strong partnership between a maverick lady detective and a gay police interpreter!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

172627.description:
One day, Miwa, a hard-working office lady, happens to run into Kudo-kun, a boy she liked in high school! Kudo-kun is working at a childcare center and seems to be having a lot of fun at his job. Miwa, who is stressed out with work, unintentionally blurts out “I wish I could be a kid again..." and Kudo-kun unexpectedly gives her the OK, telling her “We can make it like a game of pretend!"

A serious office lady and a doting babysitter experience the forbidden thrill of baby love!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

172628.description:
After my sudden death, I was reincarnated in a strange world with a sultan and his harem, but not as a person, but as a kitten who can't talk! I can only become human by kissing a prince who is worthy of the sultan... After mistaking me for an assassin and treating me coldly, Prince Soliman says, "It's soft, it's warm, can we stay here for a while?" as he approaches me.

Prince Theron, who I thought was a sweetheart, seduces me by whispering, "Choose me over my brother, and I will give you everything you want." "I will give you everything you want," he whispered, seducing me. I can't stay human unless I kiss one of them. How do I survive in this royal palace?

(Source; KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Sultan's Precious Cat
Le secret du petit chaton du sultan

172630.description:
Go Pung-rim, a boy who wants to live as an ordinary student, exorcises the ‘karma’ that is created by eating emotions...

"I am living a more tiring life than anyone else...There, it's done! just... Please be normal now."

Can’t just normal students do it?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Can't I Just Be a Student?

172632.description: After a girl’s mother joins a convent and mysteriously disappears, she decides to enter the convent herself to try and get to the bottom of what happened to her. Formerly a juvenile delinquent, she has to rely on all of her street-smart to survive in the nightmarish convent. Soon after joining, she is exposed to a culture of flagellation, sexualised corporal punishment and a lesbian mother superior. She has to constantly fight to survive, but the worst is yet to come when the bishop visits – a depraved man who after feeling that god has abandoned him decides to take out his hatred on the female members of the church.

title.native: 大奥秘帳 尼寺淫花

172641.description:
At 28 years old, Nireko has worked part-time for three years at the workshop of the umbrella craftsman Kiyota. But she's had a crush on Kiyota for 20-odd years, even though he's now married. She isn't even considered a "regular employee" there, so she sees no future for her love life nor her professional life. Then she's suddenly asked to take over her family's brush shop? "A brush shop... that's so dull!" And so begins the apprenticeship of Nireko, youngest of three daughters, to become an artisan brush-maker.

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

The fantasy story centers on Airi, a rural witch who desires to move to the kingdom's capital and get to know more people, but finds herself unable to due to her introvert nature. However, she finds her abilities unknowingly thrive in the hinterlands, where she uses spirits to aid in agriculture, and accidentally driving off raiders and beasts, sometimes saving the kingdom without even knowing. Meanwhile, her younger sister Riel is enrolled in the capital's academy for elite witches, and boasts so much of her sister that even the capital is abuzz with rumors about this so-called prodigy witch Airi.

(Source: AnimeNewsNetwork)

172690.description:
Maazen, an alchemist in the twilight of his life, has poured his heart and soul into perfecting his craft. Yet, a sense of unfulfillment haunts him. In order to continue his research, he drinks an elixir of rejuvenation, which sends him into a deep slumber. Upon awakening, his finds that his youth has been restored! However, five centuries have passed, and alchemy is nowhere near what it once was.

Undeterred by the negative perception of alchemists, Maazen is determined to continue his research. Armed with the long-forgotten knowledge of advanced alchemy, he navigates the challenges of this new, unfamiliar world! From the author of hit fantasy series, “The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest” and “My Isekai Life”, Shinkoshoto.

A beautiful high school girl suddenly shows up at the door of Yuya Amae, a tired salaryman!
It is Aoi Shiratori, his childhood friend, who has come to ask Yuya to marry her… again!
And so begins their life of living together! Yuya tries to act like a responsible guardian, but Aoi's aggressive approach is causing his resolve to waver…?

A JK childhood friend with a marriage proposal! A sweet ideal romantic comedy!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

172695.description:
Infamously known as Phantom Solitaire, the dramatic illusionist Tena Sorimura is always searching for the perfect audience who will appreciate his lavish performances. However, since stealing priceless paintings and making entire buildings disappear aren’t exactly “legal”, he often catches the attention of the authorities.

Uncover the origin of this magician-turned-criminal prankster in this biographical spinoff manga from Dead Mount Death Play. Fans of the original series can look forward to familiar troublemakers and police officers from the original series, along with some new faces. Come one, come all, and let the DEATH PLAY begin!

(Source: Manga UP!)

172696.description:
Born blind, Kunon aims to be the first person to use water magic to create new eyes for himself. After five months of study, he has already surpassed his teacher, and continues to grow his talents. Not only can his magic help him sense color, but he can also use it to make handy items and even conjure a whole cat! Word of his skills and ingenuity soon reach the court and earn him a spot as disciple to the most powerful magician in the land. But is his ultimate goal even attainable?

(Source: Yen Press)

172697.description:
One day, the Son of God came to the school. Her name is Go Deung Shin. Since her arrival, Go Deung Shin has shown many miracles, such as raising a sitting person, knocking down the school’s bully, reviving the dead, and other such miracles. Bae Du Hong, a loser at school, was reborn by Go Deung Shin, and he fights as the first apostle to prove the miracles of Go Deung Shin. But is she, or is he really the son of God? Or…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

At the age of eight, I realised I had reincarnated as the nefarious final boss of an otome game, Queen Pride. Her fighting strength is high because she’s final last boss who will battle with the main character, and her superior wits and cunning make her the most powerful crown princess in a matriarchal country. Since she brings misfortune to all that surrounds her, what awaits is a future of ruination! …really, wouldn’t it be better if I died?

I know, I’ll avoid fighting the main character and my bad ending by freely using my position of authority and cheat abilities to save everyone!

A continuation of the previous, cancelled adaptation.

비극의 원흉이 되는 최강악역 최종보스 여왕은 국민을 위해 헌신합니다. To The Savior

title.native: 悲劇の元凶となる最強外道ラスボス女王は民の為に尽くします。～To The Savior～
title.romaji: Higeki no Genkyou to Naru Saikyou Gedou Last Boss Joou wa Tami no Tame ni Tsukushimasu. To The Savior

172703.description:
Kai Shinjo, an ordinary high school student by day and a deadly assassin by night, hides behind his quiet, dark demeanor, making him an outcast among his classmates. One day, his entire class is transported to another world — a realm of swords and magic. There, a woman named Leonora reveals they were summoned as Hero candidates to defeat the Demon Lord. Each student receives a Blessing, but Kai’s power, Appraisal, seems useless compared to others’. Yet, with his assassin’s skills and cold precision, Kai begins to move in the shadows of this new world.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Strongest Assassin Gets Transferred to Another World With His Whole Class

title.english: The Top Assassin in Another World
title.native: 最強暗殺者、クラス転移で異世界へ
title.romaji: Saikyou Ansatsusha, Class Ten'i de Isekai e

synonyms: It Shouldn't Have Turned Out Like This, Thought the Femboy

title.native: こんなはずじゃなかった男の娘
title.romaji: Konna Hazu Janakatta Otoko no Musume

title.native: 羽目鳥さんは撮られたい！～可愛い教え子は露出好き～
title.romaji: Hamedori-san wa Toraretai! Kawaii Oshiego wa Roshutsu Suki

172706.description:
The "genius boy artist" who's the talk of the town is actually a girl named Gisele! But then Logan, a mean-spirited attendant of the chancellor, discovers her true identity! Threatened into doing whatever he says so that he'll keep quiet, Gisele has her masterful painting skill put to use by helping to look for the person who caused a suspicious death in the royal palace. Worse yet, he begins touching her and treating her like she's his girlfriend... even though he knows she just wants to be treated like a "man". This attendant is a complete sadist!

(Source: B's-Log Bunko, translated)

title.native: 天才宮廷画家の憂鬱 ドＳな従者に『男装』がバレて脅されています
title.romaji: Tensai Kyuuteigaka no Yuuutsu: Do-S na Juusha ni "Dansou" ga Barete Odosareteimasu

172711.description: Note: Published in Kimyou na Koibito No. 1

title.native: ドキドキ 巨乳のおばさんと遊ぼう
title.romaji: Dokidoki Kyonyuu no Oba-san to Asobou

172712.description:
When Lee Yoojung’s boss runs off with her money and her boyfriend disappears into the night, she’s not having the greatest time. Sure, her job wasn’t great and her boyfriend was nothing special, but did they really have to do this?! After an evening lamenting to a friend, she learns of a juicy opportunity…an interview at a company, but everything has to be kept top-secret! Intrigued and in need of new employment, Yoojung decides to give it a shot. With the promise of super sexy colleagues and oh-so-exciting new responsibilities, will Yoojung truly be able to satisfy her potential new bosses?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

172713.description:
Here's the sweet, bloody yakuza love story we've all been waiting for! Nezumi was raised by the mob to be an emotionless killing machine, but a chance encounter in an arcade leads to a romance at total odds with everything she's known. Equal parts ultraviolence and kawaii, Nezumi's First Love turns both the hitman and love comedy genres on their heads!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Nezumi - Willst du mit mir morden gehen?

172714.description:
Yua Hayakawa used to love playing with Chi, a mysterious girl with a murky family life who likes collecting dead insects, but it’s been years since they've spoken. Now, Chi hardly ever even comes to school. One day, Chi shows up to class in beat-up gym clothes with a handful of dead bugs and starts a commotion that gives Yua’s classmate, golden boy Koudai, an idea: he’s going to save Chi, and he needs Yua’s help to do it. But clean-cut exteriors don’t always promise good intentions, and the darkness in Chi may be more dangerous than Yua had ever imagined.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Prequel spin-off of the movie Poison Girl (Doku Musume).

172716.description:
A former "Fountain Goddess" who married a human feels depressed when her father-in-law tells her that "you're not a goddess anymore." A vampire who left her job after giving birth is worried about returning to work. A former mermaid cannot honestly appreciate the success of her friend who is now working as a mermaid model.... A "fairy tale for adults" dedicated to mothers and fathers who live with self-doubt in their daily lives.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

172717.description:
Shosuke, a college student, receives an invitation from his uncle and decides to visit Hinamori Village, his mother's family home, with his girlfriend Marika. Shosuke is confused by the hospitality of his uncle, Masanobu, but does not feel bad about it, until his uncle asks him to impregnate his wife. Shosuke is confused by the charm of being able to do whatever he wants with the sensuous body of Miku, a young wife who is older than Masanobu, but he refuses because he has a lover. Then, on Masanobu's orders, Miku started having oral sex...!?

(Source: Paradigm, translated)

title.native: 背徳の寝取らせ若妻・未玖～叔父の巨乳妻に注ぐ精～
title.romaji: Haitoku no Netorase Wakazuma: Miku "Oji no Kyonyuu Tsuma ni Sosogu Sei"

172719.description:
Tatsuya, a college student, is in love with his classmate Saki. However, he has a special propensity for cuckolding, and one day Saki finds out about it. "...Are you interested, Takkun? I'm having sex with other people." - With those words, the two start swapping with a close senior couple, Marina and Masao. Furthermore, a man and a woman appear who join their secret relationship, and the lewd party becomes more exciting...!!
(Paradigm Bunko, translated)

title.romaji: Boku to Kanojo no Midara na Utage

title.native: シコが丘ニュータウン変態パーティ

172721.description:
A formerly unsuccessful idol turned vagrant, "Sumire-chan" (31 y.o.)

A vanquished survivor of the cutthroat competition in the showbiz world, with her mind and body both beaten by the struggle, she now lives in a run-down apartment where she spends her days lazing around, for the time being. Her cousin "Yuusei", a first-year highschooler, has been keeping an eye on her and comes to her with a proposal for a moneymaking idea.

"You have a nice body, so let's release a doujin gravure photobook." Will Sumire-chan actually be able to stage a comeback in the world of the Reiwa era!? Let's stay tuned!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 平成敗残兵☆すみれちゃん

172722.description:
After a long day at work, a salaryman returns home too exhausted to even masturbate, only to have his apartment invaded by a male succubus looking for a fix! He doesn’t normally swing that way, but the intruder is pretty darn cute… and willing to take his mind off his woes by spoiling him rotten.

(Source: Fakku!)

172723.description:
A hot topic on social media! It's the best kind of laughter from the most vulgar 4-koma romcom♡

Airi-chan, a naturally airheaded heroine, loves her childhood friend Yuu-kun. However, both her feelings of love and lust are sky-high, and she's always getting into lewd accidents! Meanwhile, the shadow of NTR by a shallow playboy is creeping around Airi-chan!?

Good boys and girls who read this when they're alone should have a tissue in one hand, okay♫

(Source: Young Magazine Web, translated)

title.native: どう頑張ってもHになっちゃう幼なじみ
title.romaji: Dou Ganbatte mo H ni Nacchau Osananajimi

172724.description:
Fan Xian, a young man with a mysterious past, left his home in Danzhou in search of adventure. He will be tested by family, wuxia, and temple. But by overcoming these challenges, he will gradually discover the complicated truths of this world…

(Source: Tencent, translated)
