172726.description:
Yotsuba received a cute perfume as a gift from her dad. To her surprise, it's a magical perfume that can transform into anything she likes! One day, her childhood friend Iori discovers this secret...!? The unfolding romance between Yotsuba and Iori, as their closeness deepens, is something you can't take your eyes off!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

172727.description:
Chang-Jae Lee is an orphan and a high school dropout who has lived a miserable life. However, before his death, a mysterious being appears before him suggesting to grant him a wish. He says,

"I want to live a happy life with money and women!"

And that is how he became a Cult Leader.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)
synonyms: I’m The Leader Of A Cult

172728.description:
Want to find out the secret of the natural and slightly H Mizuki-sensei......!!!?

Tenma Akitaka, a curious junior high school boy, has something he can't stop thinking about. It's his homeroom teacher, Mizuki-sensei. Her glasses and dull outfit gives her a plain appearance, but for some reason she always visits the old school building with her cute face!!!!

Tenma's intellectual curiosity gets the better of him and he decides to investigate her secret. However, the more he investigates his sensei, the more her naughty and natural happenings are revealed to Tenma! He is supposed to be investigating her, but all he can do is satisfy his H-seeking curiosity! Can he keep up with Mizuki-sensei's naughty happenings and explore her secrets?

The teacher is a natural and satisfies your intellectual curiosity in this exciting, secret, observational romantic comedy...♪

172729.description:
Every morning at 6:58, commuters hurry onto the train at Sakuranomiya Station. For the past few months, a tentative romance has been brewing between two students from different schools. The young man is easily flustered, always stealing a glance at the young woman, but never making a move—much to the disappointment of the other passengers, who have been cheering them on in secret. Will this budding love story ever blossom?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning.

title.english: They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning

172730.description: kxs is doujin follow-up to original Kiss×sis manga written and ilustrated by original creator Bow Ditama and published on his PixivFANBOX. Unlike the original manga, this series is already fully pornographic and contains explicit sex scenes between the characters.

172731.description:
When Tomoya was in high school, he once went to a gay bar while lying about his age, and he has never been able to forget Kei, the mature and sexy man he met there. Inspired by Kei, who told him that he was cute, Tomoya has become a very popular idol with a stadium tour in the works. One day, Tomoya discovers Kei, the man of his dreams, backstage at his group's live concert! It turns out that Kei has been hired to be Tomoya's bodyguard to protect him from a stalker!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Off Stage (オフステージ)".
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: オフステージラブサイド

172732.description:
Matsubara is just one of many ladies in the Planning Division who are feeling rather annoyed. Her fellow coworker, Miwa Iida, is managing to drag the entire office down with every move she makes. And the men surrounding her in the office are only managing to make that worse. "This has to stop... Someone do something!" After finally reaching her limit, Matsubara heads to HR where she meets Asari Kuga, a woman a stern gaze who spits facts like a machine gun... the "Office Detective"!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

172733.description:
Souichirou's wife's wanted to retire to the countryside, but soon after they achieve this dream, she dies. So he won't be left alone, their pet cat Nii turns into a talking nekomata, a two-tailed yokai cat. Together they share a heartwarming slow life, cooking and eating delicious food surrounded by nature. Enjoy freshly baked bread, handmade jam, fluffy omelets, and seasonal vegetables with the members of this unusual household.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: ねこまたとあさごはん

172734.description:
The story of an animal eared prostitute boy that was leftover and unsold.
Should he remain unsold, he will be disposed of by his current owner in three days, so he tries his best to make a good impression on his final client / master...

title.native: たぶんきっと、明日のナズナは
title.romaji: Tabun Kitto, Ashita no Nazuna wa

172735.description:
Even the weakest monsters have a dream of becoming human and for one slime, that dream is coming true!

When a curious slime monster comes across a fresh corpse, an opportunity presents itself: take over the body and become a human. Easy, right? Except, the body that the slime took belongs to Lady Jelly, a heinous, unhinged young noblewoman whose villainous personality may be the reason why her corpse ended up in the forest. There’s no turning back for this slime—the only thing she can do is turn this villainess into a beloved saint! But if her true nature as a slime is discovered, this dream will be over before it even starts. Can a simple slime change Lady Jelly’s reputation and keep herself alive in order to become a beloved saintess? Or is this weak creature doomed to stay at the bottom of the food chain forever?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

172736.description: Also contains a manga adaptation of Louis Hémon's novel "Maria Chapdelaine" titled Shiroki Mori no Chi ni (白き森の地に)

172737.description: Also contains Marine no Shinju (マリーネの真珠)

4. Moetsukite Baron (燃えつきてバロン)

1. Chichuukai no Ruka (地中海のルカ)

3. Noichigo Hakusho (野いちご白書)

172742.description:
I intended to become the world's strongest "man", but I ended up becoming the world's strongest "woman"...?!
The adventurer, Lydel, wanted the sacred stone, "Baetyl's Eye", to make him the strongest "man" in the world.
The result? Lydel became strongest, but turned into a girl at the same time.
In order for her to return to being a male, Lydel embarks on an adventure to find a new sacred stone, but...?
synonyms: Don't Think That I'll Always Be A Cute Girl!
Don't Think That I'll Be Cute Forever! ~If You Make A Wish From The Sacred Stone, You'll Become The World's Strongest Beautiful Girl~

title.native: いつまでも可愛くしてると思うなよ！～聖石に願ったら最強の美少女になりました～
title.romaji: Itsu made mo Kawaiku Shiteru to Omou na yo! - Hijiriishi ni Negattara Saikyou no Bishoujo ni Narimashita

172743.description:
Ogura is middle-aged and unemployed, living off his parents' inheritance. Drunk, he brings home a huge bivalve he had picked up on the riverbed directly in front of his house to eat. Inside it, however, was a child, Kainoko-chan! He(?) is a skilled talker, having listened to FM radio for many years! What's more, an unending supply of fermented foods and other preservable seasonings can be extracted from his shell! Thus begins the unusual days of the shell child and Ogura....

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 大粒！ かいのこちゃんのHAKKO日和

172744.description: After hearing there’s a demon lurking in a village near the border, Albrea, the kingdom’s strongest knight, sets out to slay the monster. When she arrives in town, however, she quickly discovers that all is not as it seems. It turns out the humble town of Montt has a lesser-known nickname—the Maxed-Out Village—and the mighty demon is a retired old man! Montt is also inhabited by a stew-loving demonic sword that likes to take the form of a young girl, a money-grubbing witch, and a drunken priest known as the Holy Fist... Just what are so many of the kingdom’s greatest defenders doing in such a remote town? Through her encounter with the kindly old demon and the rest of the Maxed-Out Village, Albrea will learn what it truly means to be a knight!

title.english: The Retired Demon of the Maxed-Out Village
title.native: カンスト村のご隠居デーモンさん
title.romaji: Counter Stop Mura no Goinkyo Demon-san

172745.description:
Akira Godai is a brilliant student who one day had his father, an unsuccessful painter, killed in a traffic accident, forcing him to work part-time as a door boy at a bar in Ginza to pay for his school fees.
One day, Akira found a wallet containing a large sum of money left in a jacket entrusted to him by a customer, which he took with him to the bathroom, took the money inside and threw the wallet out the window; that quickly backfires, as a passerby saw him throwing the wallet, leading to his arrest. Now, as Akira is sent to prison, he'll have to struggle to survive in this harsh environment.

172748.description:
"Which is the real you!?"
Likes: Cooking, eating, and being pampered.
Specialty: Murder.

Krische Alberinea Christand, a general of the Alberan Kingdom, is the greatest genius in both military and magical history. She is the prodigy who single-handedly brought an end to the era of swords and heroes through numerous magical revolutions. Though widely feared as a cold-blooded and unparalleled slaughterer, the reality of her character is quite different. She is actually a slightly gluttonous, affectionately spoiled girl who cheerfully asks, "Ehehe, what's for dinner today?"

This somewhat airheaded and eccentric girl has but one simple wish: to spend peaceful days with the people she holds dear. Nothing more. However, as if to mock those desires, a cruel fate forces a sword into the hands of a 12-year-old village girl, dragging her onto a battlefield ruled by death and violence.

An unprecedented, common-sense-defying ultimate heroine makes her appearance! She offers an angel's smile to those she loves, and a single, fatal flash of the blade to those who oppose her. Follow the kingdom's strongest god of war as she traces the guideposts to happiness in this "girls' memento mori."

172749.description:
The very tall Kiyoko Naito is 5'9". She's outgoing, dependable, and is like a big sister to everyone. As a child, she dreamed of becoming a beautiful princess, but as she grew older and taller, she found herself becoming more like the "knight" that protects the other girls around her.

Mikoto Himeno is a younger guy who works at the same office as Kiyoko. People call him a gloomy and incompetent loser, which makes Kiyoko worry about him. One day, she finds an opportunity to talk to Mikoto properly and discovers an astonishing truth about him.

Himeno decides that she's going to step up and help this guy, whom everyone has the wrong idea about.

She promises to protect him if he gets into any trouble and urges him to stop hiding his true self! From then on, he becomes the "princess" and she his "knight"...!

A romantic comedy about a boy as beautiful as a princess, and the girl who serves as his "bodyguard"!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Mr. Princess And Ms. Knight -How My Super Cute Younger Coworker Became My Boyfriend
title.native: プリンセスくんとナイトさん～最強にカワイイ後輩が、彼氏なワケ～
title.romaji: Princess-kun to Knight-san: Saikyou ni Kawaii Kouhai ga, Kareshi na Wake

172750.description:
"Why do boys find underwear and breasts so erotic?"

Let's study this question in depth with Densuke Murai, the "perverted gentleman," in this academic (?) ecchi comedy!

(Source: Cycomics, translated)

title.native: 夢ヶ原さんは夢見がち！

172753.description:
Lin, the eldest daughter of the Takato family, who runs Umetou, a long-established dried plum company in Wakayama, has a prodigious memory, but spends her days in the plum grove observing the plums. However, misfortune and mysterious events begin to unfold when Mei-hua from Taiwan marries Dan, the eldest son of the Takato family, the president of Umetou. When Lin, who has a hunch that Mei-hua is not an ordinary woman, questions her, Mei-hua tells him about her unexpected past!　
The unpredictable drama of women shaking up a world heritage site opens with a shocking twist!

172754.description: My beloved uncle passed away in an accident, my father left home, and I stopped crying - an amazing youth motorcycle story that takes place around high school student Touma Fujieda! It is sure to thrill both bike lovers and non-bike lovers alike!

172755.description: Sixteen-year-old high school student Takeshi Chimatsuri has devoted his life to being a master samurai like his father was. Then one day, the Toki twins, two ninja sisters he's known since childhood, transfer to his school and issue him a challenge to take back their family dagger from him. Unfortunately for him, they have discovered his one weakness: the fear of the naked female body. Now, Takeshi must undergo special training from his classmates Atsuko and Torai, and his teacher Miss Ayatsugi to resist the combined brute strength of Akari and the temptation of her sex-crazed twin Kagiri. Class will never be in order with these three constantly fighting each other.

172756.description: Note: The chapters 1-6 were later published in the tankoubon Osanaki Hana: Kami Haramishi Otome (幼き花‧鬼胎少女)

ご主人様は召使いがお好き?

3. Josou Kareshi x Ore Kan (女装彼氏×俺 完!!)

酔った先輩に連れられて男の娘ヘルスに来てみた件

Jinkyung is a young doctor who has her eye on a promotion. The only problem is, all the obstacles she has to get through to achieve her goal. Makoto secretly loves cake. He begs his twin sister Mikoto to go to a cake shop with him, and she agrees on the condition Makoto lets her practice her makeup skills on him! The transformed Makoto, who is by all appearances a girl, arrives at the cake shop still worried about raising suspicion. There, he meets the handsome pastry-chef-in-training, Kazumi. Impressed with the flavor of the cakes he tries, Makoto continues to disguise himself just to visit the store. When he's offered handmade desserts that aren't normally for sale, Makoto isn't quite sure how to deal with the special treatment. The affection he senses in Kazumi, who doesn't know Makoto's true gender, shakes Makoto to his core......

This charming love story of a sweet-talking pastry chef and an innocent boy with a sweet tooth is the perfect read to go with your afternoon snack.

(Source: Renta!)

There, he encounters Adele, the formidable leader of a local vigilante corps known as the Black Wolves. Feared even by the town’s most hardened men, Adele exudes overwhelming presence and authority. And yet... against all odds, Haruo somehow finds himself entangled in an unexpectedly erotic turn of events with her.

Having only ever interacted with girls through adult games, Haruo puts his eroge brain into overdrive in an effort to gain the upper hand over Adele-sama. And eventually… his manhood ends up inside her.

Minori is the only daughter of the Sano's, a happy, picture-perfect family. One day, Minori, cheerful as ever, returns home to get something, and encounters a burglar who had broken into the house. Minori pursues the thief as he tries to escape, falling off the balcony in the process. When the robber catches her as she lands, they end up swapping bodies with each other! Nicola von Weber is no ordinary schoolgirl. Endowed with memories of a past life as a Shinto exorcist and natural psychic abilities, she uses her exorcism skills to protect others from malevolent apparitions. In this first installment, Nicola clashes with ghosts, doppelgangers, and more than one ill-fated romance. Most spooky apparitions seem to spawn around the school, where the students' propensity for gossip provides ample sustenance for their existence. Here, the more vividly one imagines something, the more likely it is to come true. However, as first-year student Nicola ventures beyond her schoolgirl life at The Royal Academy, she finds that the tenacity of spirits (and grudges) means that they can turn up in the strangest of places.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

This is a slightly romantic coming-of-age story in which two high school boys with opposite personalities slowly come to terms with their feelings and each other over time!

172962.description:

Out of necessity, he decides to close down Yume no Yu. On their last day of business, after seeing off the last customer, Tomohiro and Yuka were cleaning up one last time to express their gratitude for the years of service, when they found an old wooden box in a corner of the boiler room. When he opened it, he discovered something strange sealed inside. It is the beginning of a miraculous story about the revival of a public bathhouse on the verge of collapse!

(Source: Orgis Novel, translated)
